high_level_description: The image depicts a nighttime scene at Windsor Castle, a historic stone structure with multiple towers and battlements. The castle is illuminated by artificial lighting, which highlights its architectural details. On the walls of one of the towers, large images of two individuals are projected. One image appears to be of Jeffrey Epstein, recognizable by his distinctive hairstyle and attire, while the other is of Donald Trump, identifiable by his facial features and formal clothing. In the foreground, there are several people gathered, some of whom appear to be observing the projections.
